title: Data selector/multiplexer 8-1

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. (1976), section 7, TYPES SN54150, SN54151A, SN54152A, SN54LS151, SN54LS152, SN54S151, SN74150, SN74151A, SN74LS151, SN74S151 Data selectors/multiplexers, bulletin DL-S 7611819 (revised October 1976)

functions.formula: Y = STROBE' AND ((C' AND B' AND A' AND D0) OR (C' AND B' AND A AND D1) OR (C' AND B AND A' AND D2) OR (C' AND B AND A AND D3) OR (C AND B' AND A' AND D4) OR (C AND B' AND A AND D5) OR (C AND B AND A' AND D6) OR (C AND B AND A AND D7))
functions.text: With STROBE low, Y follows the data input D0-D7 picked by C,B,A. STROBE high forces Y low.
Complement of Y; STROBE high forces W high.

unknown: The datasheet read is for the SN74151A (the 'A' version); the original SN74151 without suffix was not found as a separate datasheet.
notes: whenInactive for STROBE is not one of the single words in FORMAT.md: the two outputs go to different levels (Y low, W high). The '151A has address buffers with symmetrical delays through the complementary paths.
